bullets.text: The financial sector exhibits high resilience, backed by banks maintaining a capital adequacy ratio of 23 percent.
Systemic risks in the real estate market have heightened as housing loans expand at 27 percent y/y alongside house price overvaluation of 10–15 percent.
Bulgaria faces a low overall risk of sovereign stress, with public debt projected to increase from 23.8 percent of GDP in 2024 to 38.5 percent of GDP in 2034.
Headline inflation remains elevated and is projected to average around 3½ percent in 2025 and 2026.
Downside risks dominate the outlook, with an adverse external scenario potentially lowering growth by 0.1–0.2 percentage points on average per year over 2025–30.
Euro adoption in January 2026 presents liquidity management challenges as domestic bank reserve requirements drop by 11 percentage points to 1 percent of eligible liabilities.
